name: momentum_reversion_switch_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY/BANKNIFTY, intraday sessions alternate between two microstructure states: (1) directional flow, where large institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms push the index with sustained order imbalance visible as ADX > 25 on a 5-minute window — in this state, a 1.5-minute EMA crossing above a 3.5-minute EMA signals order-flow acceleration already underway, predicting 15-25 more spot points of continuation within 30-60 seconds; and (2) range-bound churning, where market makers are net-flat and delta-hedging activity creates tight oscillations — ADX < 18 identifies this state, and 2-sigma Bollinger Band extremes on a 5-minute window flag overshoots that market makers fade within 30 seconds, recovering 10-20 spot points back toward the band midline.
core_signal_oneliner: ADX-based regime classifier routing to EMA-crossover momentum entries (ADX > 25) or Bollinger Band extreme mean-reversion entries (ADX < 18) with VWAP confirmation
